rows.text: As a Ruin Strider, you roam among crumbling walls far from civilization, with a particular fondness for ancient tombs buried deep underground. Some say you're just after the dead's treasures, but you couldn't care less.
rows.speaker: Simulated Universe

rows.text: "Click... THUD!" A mechanism triggers, and the tomb's stone door comes crashing down. You raise your torch, illuminating the dark room ahead, where an inscription on the wall catches your eye:
rows.speaker: Simulated Universe

rows.text: "Those who have reached this place possess extraordinary courage. The Gods of Three Fates who govern destiny shall bestow upon you a reward, which marks the beginning of your legend."
rows.speaker: Simulated Universe

rows.text: At the far end of the room, a chest silently awaits. Inside lies what you desire most...
rows.speaker: Simulated Universe

rows.text: You lift the lid of the chest and take out the divine treasure that belongs to you. A gaze seems to linger from behind, or perhaps it's just a warm breeze.
rows.speaker: Simulated Universe
